entities.name: Madara
entities.description: Dominarian island nation west of Jamuraa, former seat of the Madaran Empire.

entities.name: Madaran Empire
entities.description: Empire founded c. 3226 AR and taken over by Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon planeswalker who ruled the Madaran Empire as god-emperor until exiled.

entities.name: Demonic Leviathan
entities.description: Unknown planeswalker who fought Bolas to the death at Madara.

entities.name: Shattering of Madara
entities.description: Destruction of one-third of the continent in the battle between Bolas and the Leviathan.

entities.name: Madara-Edemi War
entities.description: War during which Bolas restructured his rule.

entities.name: Ramses Overdark
entities.description: Assassin who replaced imperial officers with minions and became imperial regent; killed by Tetsuo Umezawa.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: Former champion who killed Overdark and exiled Bolas.

entities.name: Clan Umezawa
entities.description: Clan whose ancestral manor is Umezawa Manor.

entities.name: Wasitora
entities.description: Cat-dragon who migrated to Madara for dried fish from Pelada.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: Supercontinent of which Madara is now considered part.

entities.name: Talon Gates
entities.description: Rock spires at the Suido's mouth, site of the first Time Rift.

events.summary: About -15,000 AR Nicol Bolas and a Demonic Leviathan fight to the death at Madara, causing the Shattering and the first Time Rift.
events.quote: the first battle between planeswalkers on Dominaria took place at Madara

events.summary: A warrior queen founds the Madaran Empire in c. 3226 AR.
events.quote: the Madaran Eempire was founded by a warrior queen

events.summary: Bolas slays the warrior-queen in 3455 AR and takes the empire as god-emperor.
events.quote: the dragon slew the warrior-queen in 3455 AR, and took the empire

events.summary: During the Madara-Edemi War Bolas makes Ramses Overdark imperial regent as Overdark replaces other officers.
events.quote: Bolas then made a new system with only one placeholder for the emperor

events.summary: Tetsuo Umezawa kills Overdark and exiles Bolas; the empire falls into chaos.
events.quote: former champion Tetsuo Umezawa killed Overdark and exiled Bolas

relations.quote: former champion Tetsuo Umezawa killed Overdark and exiled Bolas
